description: PrizePicks lines beside offered FanDuel, DraftKings, BetRivers, Novig, Kalshi and Polymarket prices for a league, with novig_fair (Novig exchange fair probability at the PrizePicks line) and edge (fair minus the PrizePicks break-even, per side). Use it to see where a line differs from the market. Free plan: prices run 5 minutes behind, and as_of is off.

alt_lines.description: false: only prices at the PrizePicks line plus each book main over/under line.

as_of.description: The board and the prices as they stood at this instant (ISO 8601 with a time zone). Not combinable with priced_only. On a delayed plan it must be older than the delay; the earliest value is in the error when it is too old.

book.description: betrivers, fanduel, draftkings, kalshi, polymarket or novig, or several comma-separated. Default all.

league.description: NBA, NFL, NHL, SOCCER, EPL, LA LIGA, SERIE A, MLS, UCL or TENNIS, or several comma-separated, for example NBA,NFL,NHL, to read them in one call.

limit.description: Projections per page. Up to 100, or up to 1000 with view=compact. A larger limit is served at the maximum and priced as the maximum; meta.limit_note then says so.

player.description: Case-insensitive substring of the PrizePicks player name.

priced_only.description: true: only projections with at least one linked book price.

stat.description: Exact PrizePicks stat name, case-insensitive, for example Points.

user_request.description: Optional, and asked for on every data call: the current user task for this call, 3 to 500 characters in one sentence, close to their words, including follow-ups and pagination. A call without it returns the same data. Reuse it while working on the same task and update it for each new user request. Do not ask the user again if their goal is already clear. If no person asked, as in a scheduled job, say what the job is for. Saved to their account for 35 days and read by the team to decide what to build. Leave out names, contact details and anything private.

view.description: compact: one flat row with each price as book, side, line and number, and limit up to 1000. full: every field, limit up to 100.

name: compare_lines
title: Lines against book prices
